summary: Build-config fix: @cipherstash/stack's wasm-inline type declarations now come from the main tsup config's DTS pass (dts: false on the wasm-inline config), so ./wasm-inline, ./eql/v3, ./v3 and ./adapter-kit share one declaration of EncryptedV3Column. A wasm-inline-authored table can now be passed to the native Encryption, encryptedSupabase and the other adapters, and the reverse, without a compile error. Runtime JS is unchanged. The wasm-inline.js bundle and each CJS entry still carry their own runtime copy of the class. That is now only a hazard for code that uses instanceof, and the first-party code at head does not (it probes structurally and fails closed). Two dist-types gates pin the new type identity. Both run in the CI job 'Run Tests (Node 22/24)', which passed. A text guard over shipped skills was deleted, and four shipped skills were rewritten to recommend cross-entry schema sharing. The main residual risks: (1) the skills ship in the stash tarball and say 'upgrade' without naming a version, so a customer on an older @cipherstash/stack follows a now-recommended pattern and gets a compile error; (2) the type system now asserts an identity the runtime does not have, so any future instanceof check on these classes would silently fail; (3) Deno edge consumers' type resolution of the re-chunked .d.ts is not exercised by any gate. All failures are compile-time or need a future regression. Impact is medium at most.

behaviour_changes.description: dist/wasm-inline.d.ts is now emitted by the main (dual-format) tsup config, so it references the same shared declaration chunks as ./eql/v3, ./v3 and ./adapter-kit instead of inlining its own copies. The wasm-inline config now sets dts: false. A side effect is an unreferenced dist/wasm-inline.d.cts in the tarball. The exports map is unchanged and still points ./wasm-inline types at ./dist/wasm-inline.d.ts.

Type-level contract widened: tables and columns authored from @cipherstash/stack/wasm-inline are now assignable to AnyV3Table from ./eql/v3 (and so to encryptedSupabase's schemas, Drizzle and Prisma Next helpers, and native Encryption). Native-authored tables are now accepted by the WASM Encryption. Before this change both directions failed with TS2322.

Runtime class identity is unchanged: wasm-inline.js (a separate esbuild run) and each CJS entry still define their own EncryptedV3Column. Types now claim one class where the runtime has several. A new comment in adapter-kit.ts forbids instanceof on the class.

Four shipped skills (stash-edge, stash-encryption, stash-managed-platforms, stash-supabase) now recommend authoring one schema module from either entry and passing it to either client or adapter. They replace the previous 'schemas do not cross entries' rule with an 'upgrade if you see this diagnostic' note. stash-edge gains a real fence pairing encryptedSupabase (wasm-inline) with encryptedTable/types from @cipherstash/stack/wasm-inline.

Deleted scripts/__tests__/skills-supabase-edge-schema-entry.test.mjs, which failed when a shipped TS fence paired the adapter's wasm-inline entry with a wasm-inline-authored schema. Added the dist-types/wasm-inline-type-identity.ts gate and cross-entry probes in dist-types/node16/wasm-inline.mts. logger-edge-safety.test.ts now throws at import time under CI when dist/adapter-kit.js is missing, instead of skipping.
The Supabase adapter's EQL-v2-table error message now names @cipherstash/stack/wasm-inline as an accepted authoring entry. This is a wording-only change.

failure_scenarios.title: Shipped skills recommend cross-entry schemas to customers whose installed @cipherstash/stack predates the fix
failure_scenarios.trigger: A customer has the new stash skills (the stash tarball is versioned separately) but an existing project still has an older @cipherstash/stack installed. Their coding agent follows the new stash-edge fence and authors schemas from @cipherstash/stack/wasm-inline for encryptedSupabase or native Encryption.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: The skills now present cross-entry pairing as the normal path (stash-edge SKILL.md:441-446). The fallback only says 'on older versions'/'upgrade' and gives no version number (stash-edge SKILL.md:405-424, 448; stash-encryption SKILL.md:528). The deleted guard test was the only check over shipped snippets. Agents reading 'it works at runtime' plus a TS2322 error may reach for a cast.
failure_scenarios.consequence: tsc fails in the customer project with TS2322 'separate declarations of a private property columnName'. That is a loud, recoverable build failure. A worse outcome is an agent silencing it with as any/as never, which the old skills explicitly warned against. The new text still discourages that.

existing_verification.description: dist-types gates prove the new pairing compiles against this head's build only, not against older installed versions

missing_verification: No check ties the skills' claims to a minimum @cipherstash/stack version
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Name the first @cipherstash/stack version carrying the fix in the four skills, for example 'requires @cipherstash/stack >= <next patch>'. Optionally keep the eql/v3-authoring example first for the Supabase adapter path.

failure_scenarios.title: Types now assert one EncryptedV3Column while runtime has several copies, so a future instanceof check silently misclassifies wasm-authored tables
failure_scenarios.trigger: Future first-party or customer code adds `x instanceof EncryptedV3Column` (or a module-local brand) on a path that receives schemas. A wasm-inline-authored table now passes the compiler, which it did not before.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: tsup still emits separate runtime class copies (wasm-inline.js is a separate esbuild run, and CJS entries do not split) per tsup.config.ts:70-83 and the adapter-kit.ts:31-40 comment. The compile error used to stop TS users from passing wasm-authored tables across entries. That error is gone. The historical consequence of a failed identity check in the Supabase adapter was an empty v3Columns map and plaintext filter operands in PostgREST URLs.
failure_scenarios.consequence: If such a check were added, filter operands could silently be treated as plaintext or columns skipped. No such check exists at head: column-map.ts probes structurally, fails closed (column-map.ts:189) and has tests using wasm-authored table mocks.

failure_scenarios.mitigation: Add a lint (Biome/GritQL or a grep test) that rejects instanceof EncryptedV3Column / EncryptedV3Table in packages/*/src. Optionally add a runtime test over a built dist that pairs a wasm-inline table with encryptedSupabase.

failure_scenarios.title: Re-chunked wasm-inline declarations fail to resolve or degrade to any for edge type-checkers
failure_scenarios.trigger: An edge consumer (Deno check, Workers with a bundler tsconfig) resolves dist/wasm-inline.d.ts, which now imports shared chunk files from the main DTS pass instead of being self-contained.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: tsup.config.ts:52 adds src/wasm-inline.ts to the main config's dts entry list, so rollup-plugin-dts splits shared declarations into chunks. Chunks shared with Node-only entries could carry imports the edge consumer cannot resolve. The built output was not inspected.
failure_scenarios.consequence: A compile error or silently any-typed exports for edge TS users. Runtime is unaffected.

missing_verification: Deno type-check of the wasm-inline entry (e2e/wasm runs deno test --no-check)
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Inspect the packed dist/wasm-inline.d.ts and its chunk imports, or run `deno check` on a minimal wasm-inline schema before release.

verification_gaps.description: The skills' 'upgrade' guidance names no minimum version, and nothing checks skill snippets against a published version.
The no-instanceof rule for v3 column classes is a comment, not an enforced check, and no runtime test uses a real built wasm-inline table.
The emitted declarations were not inspected, and the Deno e2e skips type-checking.

recommended_controls.description: State the minimum @cipherstash/stack version in the four rewritten skills.
Add a lint or grep test forbidding instanceof EncryptedV3Column/EncryptedV3Table in package src.
Before publish, pack @cipherstash/stack and inspect dist/wasm-inline.d.ts imports; optionally run deno check over a wasm-inline schema module.
Reviewer should confirm that the tsup dts entry list stays derived from mainEntry plus wasm-inline, and that no future config re-enables dts on the wasm-inline config.

./wasm-inline export is import-only with types ./dist/wasm-inline.d.ts (unchanged).

Supabase adapter types schemas as Record<string, AnyV3Table> from @cipherstash/stack/eql/v3.

isV3ColumnLike recognises v3 columns structurally.
